patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Third Halloween party in a row with this face paint, and now my skin is angrier than the character. It itches like fire.
presentation.triageNote: 38-year-old female with an itchy red rash confined exactly to where green theatrical greasepaint was applied 24 hours ago, with no mucosal or systemic involvement.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this sharply exposure-limited contact dermatitis has no mucosal, airway, or systemic involvement and requires no counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has an itchy facial rash matching the exact distribution of newly applied theatrical greasepaint.
clinical.acuityReason: The precise contact pattern and absence of systemic allergy features support localized dermatitis.
keyFindings: Itchy red rash exactly follows application area
teachingPoints: Removing the trigger is the primary intervention.
Facial swelling, wheeze, vomiting, hypotension, blistering, or mucosal disease would change concern.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Removal of the product, gentle skin care, and topical treatment would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 38-year-old woman in a witch costume with a pointed hat set aside on her lap, patchy green face paint partly wiped away, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting with a pointed witch hat resting on her lap, one hand hovering near her cheek without touching it
signs: angry red blotchy rash exactly where green face paint was applied
a witch hat on her lap
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. ANATOMY AND OBJECTS (critical): exactly one head, exactly two arms ending in exactly two hands, exactly two legs ending in two feet, five fingers on each hand. No extra, duplicated, floating or partial limbs anywhere. Anything the character touches must be plausibly held by one of those two hands. All furniture is solid and fully opaque - the chair must never look transparent or see-through, and its back, seat and legs must all be completely drawn. Subject: a white 38-year-old woman in a witch costume, WEARING a tall pointed black witch hat on her head, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright wearing the pointed hat, one hand hovering near her cheek without quite touching it. Expression: itchy, irritated and faintly embarrassed. Clearly visible: a tall pointed black witch hat worn on the head; VIVID, saturated bright green face paint still covering patches of her face where it has been partly wiped away; an angry red blotchy rash exactly where the green paint was applied, stopping precisely at the edge of the painted area. Overall: entirely well and extremely itchy. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
